title: Remember Something: - Make It Weird: Add Something Bizarre or Unusual to the Idea
description: To remember something: - Make it weird: Add something bizarre or unusual to the idea or fact. - Visualize it vividly: Picture the bizarre element as vividly as possible. - Tell a story: Embed the information in a strange, memorable scenario. Example: To remember someone’s name (e.g., Daisy), imagine them wearing a giant daisy hat.
